posts.title: A game of zones: A cartographic exploration of Colorado's strangest city limits
posts.description: Part of a 1996 Rand McNally map of the Denver area, showing how different municipalities were shaded in different colors. One thing I always appreciated about the old Rand McNally street maps was how each municipality was shaded in a different color with clear boundaries, making it easy to see where one stopped and another began. posts.title: Tokio internals: Understanding Rust's asynchronous I/O framework from the bottom up
